steps.reason_for_choice: The full window would consume almost the entire budget before any optimization. A broad mid/high-pressure window covering all allowed temperatures and separator temperatures should identify feasibility/cost tradeoffs for the only candidates not screenable by candidate_13 if it wins (candidate_04 and candidate_05), while leaving enough budget for optimization, parity/reachability, and edge checks if the optimum lies at a window boundary.

known_evidence.notable_price_activity_tradeoff: candidate_13 is cheapest (8 USD/kg) and third-highest in reference activity; if it becomes current lowest-cost, it screens all candidates except higher-activity candidate_04 and candidate_05 by the declared rule (lower activity and higher price).
known_evidence.descriptor_uncertainty: Most candidates uniform +/-0.15 eV; candidate_13 normal sigma 0.227 eV.

steps.reason_for_choice: These are the only candidates that must be compared to establish a likely industrial winner under the declared dominance screen: candidate_13 is cheap and high-activity; candidate_04 is highest activity; candidate_05 is second-highest activity. Candidate_05 has higher price and lower activity than candidate_04, so it may become screenable if candidate_04 is feasible/lower cost, but optimizing it is still affordable and verifies that its expensive metal does not alter the process optimum. Lower-activity candidates all have higher price than candidate_13 and can be screened if candidate_13 wins.

known_evidence.screening_implication: If candidate_13 is feasible and lowest among candidate_04/05/13, then all lower-activity higher-price candidates are screened; candidates_04/05 remain unresolved because higher activity despite much higher price.

The principal risk that could change the winner, a high-pressure improvement for candidate_04, has already been tested and was negligible.

edge_validity.interpretation: candidate_13's Tsep edge is the global admissible maximum, so no larger Tsep state is allowed; candidate_04's T edge is the global admissible maximum and its P edge risk was checked by a focused high-P window; candidate_05 is more expensive and lower-activity/higher-price than candidate_04, and far above candidate_13.

screened_candidates.rule: lower reference activity AND higher metal price than current lowest-cost candidate_13

validity_checks.edge_risk_resolution: candidate_13's Tsep edge and candidate_04's T edge are global admissible limits; candidate_04's pressure-edge risk was directly tested with a 400-1000 bar focused window and did not change the decision.

final_answer.evidence_summary: candidate_13 is feasible and lower cost by 6.74 USD/t versus the highest-activity candidate_04 after high-pressure refinement and by 10.59 USD/t versus candidate_05. All other candidates are screened by the declared activity/price dominance rule relative to candidate_13.

chosen_args.why_stop: Stopping rule satisfied: S1 feasible optimized current lowest-cost candidate exists; S2 no unresolved candidate remains because all nonscreened competitors were optimized and the rest are screened by lower reference activity plus higher metal price; S3 highest-activity parity and reachability were executed and classified unreachable. Additional affordable actions have low expected decision value: MC could quantify descriptor-uncertainty risk but would not alter the deterministic industrial decision supported by a large cost gap and unreachable parity; bed-cap/vessel-floor checks are unlikely to overturn the winner because candidate_13 has substantial bed-cap slack and low reactor-cost contribution.

unresolved_decision_risk.descriptor_uncertainty_not_MC_quantified: candidate_13 has a broader descriptor uncertainty distribution than most candidates, so stochastic win probability was not computed; residual risk is judged low-to-moderate but not decision-changing under the stopping rule.
unresolved_decision_risk.process_window_scope: Optimization used a broad screen window plus focused candidate_04 high-pressure extension rather than the full 10-1000 bar grid; residual risk is mainly excluded by dominance screening and targeted edge test.
unresolved_decision_risk.model_correlation_limits: No vessel-floor check was run; any small-volume correction would tend to penalize high-activity expensive candidates more than the low-cost winner.
